comment: Skirmish maps built into the mod (tools/sc2-maps/build-maps.mjs): each is a Battle.net publication, downloaded from the public depot by its header handle, converted by Modkit to a native Minecraft world. A handle is 4 bytes type, 4 bytes region, 32 bytes SHA-256 (hex); without one the build looks the publication up in the local Battle.net cache by id and version.
